name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Manager | Performance Marketing, Advertiser Portfolios & Revenue Growth

Ran client accounts end to end at two performance marketing agencies (paid media, budget planning, ROI/CAC/LTV reporting, business reviews) and retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%). Backs account strategy with a sales record (top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota doubled, 120% of targets at Wix) and hands-on analytics in Excel, GA4, and Power BI, so every client review ends with a clear recommendation and a growth path.
